summary: Designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics, including devices like Kindle family of products, Fire tablets, Fire TV, Amazon Dash, and Amazon Echo. Works on real-world problems on a global scale as part of Amazon's Devices team.
responsibilities: Think big, bringing fresh ideas and interactions that make device services development easy and intuitive
Take a long-term view of architecture, proactively fixing deficiencies and/or proposing larger projects.
Understand the business impact of your systems and show good judgment when making technical trade-offs.
Be a key influencer in team strategy.
Bring perspective and provide context to guide future technology choices.
Write software that is easy for others to contribute to.
Drive engineering best practices (e.g., Operational Excellence, Security, Quality, etc.) and set standards.
Find the best way forward when confronted with discordant views and influence others to follow that path (build consensus).
Contribute to the professional development of colleagues, improving their technical knowledge and engineering practices.
required_skills: 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
nice_to_have_skills: 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
education_level: Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
benefits: Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
